query:
-- Find duplicates by name where no opportunityId
SELECT opportunityName, COUNT(*) as cnt, GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY id) as ids, GROUP_CONCAT(opportunityId ORDER BY id) as oppIds
FROM projects
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(opportunityName))
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;
